basic_info.description: Welcome to 140 Van Ness Ave #909! This bright and spacious 1BR/1BA home offers sweeping downtown views and abundant natural light through large windows and a private balcony off the bedroomperfect for relaxing, working, or entertaining. The open-concept layout features wood floors, an open kitchen with freshly painted cabinets and stainless steel appliances, and a generous living/dining space.  The bedroom boasts new carpet, an ensuite bath, ample closet space, and direct access to the terrace.  In-unit laundry and on-site parking complete the home.    Located in the vibrant Van Ness-Mission corridor, the building offers on-site management, a fitness center, conference room, and an outdoor courtyard with seating and BBQ. Just steps from Hayes Valley, Valencia Corridor, dining, shopping, and major transit.
